name: ECC
description: The agent harness performance optimization system. Skills, instincts, memory, security, and research-first development for Claude Code, Codex, Opencode, Cursor and beyond.
one_liner: A performance-tuning layer for AI coding assistants that adds memory, security checks, and research habits so they make fewer mistakes.
buyer: A platform/DevOps lead at a mid-size engineering org standardizing how every team uses AI coding agents.
business_use_cases: An engineering platform team rolls it out org-wide to reduce AI-introduced security bugs.
A consultancy uses it as a selling point: 'our AI-assisted delivery includes built-in safety and memory.'
A solo developer uses it to keep long AI coding sessions from losing context on big refactors.

money_ideas.idea: Offer paid onboarding/configuration services for engineering orgs adopting it at scale.
Build and sell a hosted dashboard that tracks the security/instinct checks across a whole org.

steal_this: This weekend, write a one-page 'AI agent safety checklist' lead magnet using its security rules, and use it to sell setup consulting to small dev shops.
